s6.title: Behind the Bumpers | 1577 Steampunk | Charged Up Robot

auto.text: From the open side of the charge station, score two pieces and collect another. Over the charge station, score one, collect one, return and balance. From the cable-protector side, score two.

cycle.text: The operator picks a level and a piece with buttons. The floor intake centers a cone and swings up, and the arm takes it. The driver presses one button to open the arm to the chosen position and one to eject.

fallback.text: If a set point is off during a match, the team can change it from the dashboard in real time instead of losing the match and fixing it later.

changed.text: At the first district event the robot had no floor intake and lost many points because it could take only standing cones. The new intake took inspiration from another team. At the World Championship the team had just changed the intake, so the handoff angle moved further back to suit how cones met the gripper.

outcome.text: 51-12-0 in official play; ranked 14 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 72.53, Archimedes).

solves.text: Pick fallen cones off the floor quickly and center them, with a light mechanism

facts.text: Takes a cone by its square side between two rollers; a PVC pipe keeps the cone in, and mecanum and omni wheels center it
The pivot is low to the ground, so a hit pushes the intake up instead of breaking it
The intake then comes back up so the arm can grab the cone

solves.text: Rotate and extend to the scoring levels while keeping the center of gravity low

facts.text: The transmission sits low and drives the top by chain, to keep the center of gravity down
An absolute encoder meshes with the arm sprocket, so the true arm angle is known despite gear and chain backlash
It extends by a double sprocket in two rows of holes in the arm extrusion
Two connected extrusions up top give the arm more stability

cost.text: The gear ratio and chain add backlash

solves.text: Hold cones and cubes in one narrow gripper

facts.text: The pointed end of a cone passes up between the two sets of wheels; a cube is pinched by its corner or face
In polycarbonate, two shoulder bearings sit side by side with inner rings touching, so neither can pop out and no friction is added

functions.name: Arm waypoints and dashboard

solves.text: Move the arm past the grid without hitting it and correct a bad set point without leaving the match

functions.type: safe waypoints with a match-time set-point editor

facts.text: A set of safe waypoints lets the arm move around the grid without hitting it
The dashboard shows the chosen level and piece, and every set point in the field can be changed during a match
In auto, the swerve is given a field point and drives there

decisions.choice: Add a floor intake after the first district event
decisions.because: the robot lost many points because it could not pick up fallen cones
decisions.instead_of: taking only standing cones with the gripper

decisions.because: it was first sized to reach into a spindexer, and the team found it did not need widening because the floor intake centers the piece
the arm plates ride on bearings on a fixed shaft, so the encoder could not go there
decisions.instead_of: an encoder on the arm shaft
